name: Barthek's Caucasus Redone 2022
summary: Caucasus ground texture rework installed with JSGME, plus an optional snowless winter pack.
description: Caucasus terrain texture mod distributed as JSGME-ready Google Drive downloads linked from the forum thread. It overwrites files in the DCS install folder through JSGME. An optional Snowless Winter / Late Autumn pack and a ReShade preset (goes in the DCS bin folder) are also offered.
